title: Exchange Edge Transport Server Deployment & Hardening (Hybrid)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Deploy and harden the Exchange Edge Transport role the right way
problem: The Exchange Edge Transport server sits in the perimeter to handle inbound/outbound SMTP and a first layer of hygiene — and misconfigured, it becomes an open relay or a mail-flow bottleneck. This solution deploys and hardens Edge: subscribe it to the Exchange organization (EdgeSync), configure send/receive connectors and accepted domains, apply anti-spam/agent and connection-filter settings, harden the OS/TLS posture, and validate secure mail flow — so the perimeter transport is correct, secure, and monitored.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Edge Transport role in a hybrid perimeter: EdgeSync, connectors, transport agents/anti-spam, TLS, and how it complements cloud hygiene.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (on-prem Exchange org + Edge host, network/firewall/DNS, certificates, admin access).

Implementation Guide — install the Edge role, create + import the Edge Subscription (EdgeSync), configure send/receive connectors + accepted domains, apply anti-spam/connection filtering, harden OS/TLS, and validate secure inbound/outbound flow — pilot-first, each object named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (EdgeSync healthy, no open relay, TLS enforced, mail flows) plus Best Practices for a secure, maintainable Edge tier.
short: Deploy and harden the Exchange Edge Transport role — EdgeSync subscription, connectors + accepted domains, anti-spam/connection filtering, OS/TLS hardening, and secure mail-flow validation — so perimeter transport is correct and secure. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
